autoUpdateDesc: Enable this option to apply the selected filters to the product structure in real-time. Disable this option to apply the selected filters to the structure later.
boxZoneTooltip: Filter all elements that are inside, outside, intersecting, or a combination of intersecting with inside or outside, for a certain spatial zone, which is represented by a bounding box.
clearAllCmdTooltip: All the filter groups will be cleared.
createOrGroupTooltip: Create an OR group to have multiple filter criteria in a group. The selections are added to the group using the AND operator.
createNotGroupTooltip: Create a NOT group to exclude multiple filter criteria in a group. The selections are added to the group using the AND operator. The criteria placed in the NOT group will override all other group criteria.
createSessionTooltip: Создайте сессию, куда будут сохраняться фильтры и конфигурации структур.
createWorksetTooltip: Создайте рабочий набор для хранения одного или нескольких изделий.
defaultStaleStructureWarningMessage: The selected structure is not updated with the latest filters and configurations. Replay the structure to update it.
defaultStaleTreeWarningMessage: One or more structures in the Workset are not updated with the latest filters and configurations. Replay the structures to update it.
deselectValidationMsg: Нельзя очистить первый примененный фильтр, пока не удалены остальные фильтры.
elementNotFoundMessage: One or more targets are filtered out.
elementNotFoundTooltip: Although one or more targets are filtered out, the distance can be modified to affect the filtered results.
excludeDesc: Narrow the structure by excluding the selections. The selections are added to the filter criteria using the NOT operator.
excludeByFilteringDesc: Включите эту опцию, чтобы исключить элементы структуры из структуры изделия на основе выбранных атрибутов, или отключите ее, чтобы включить элементы структуры.
filtersDisabledMessage: You do not have write access to modify filters and configurations.
filterSettingsDesc: Просмотрите или измените настройки панели фильтра.
includeWithChildrenDesc: Enable this option to automatically add children to the newly created filter criteria. Disable this option if you do not want to add the children.
includeDesc: Broaden the filtered structure by including the selections with children as filters. The selections are added to the filter criteria using the OR operator.
includeWithoutChildrenDesc: Broaden the filtered structure by including the selections without children as filters. The selections are added to the filter criteria using the OR operator.
includeWithoutChildrenTooltip: Children are not included for appending.
includeWithAndDesc: Narrow the structure by including the selections with children as filters. The selections are added to the filter criteria using the AND operator.
includeWithoutChildrenAndDesc: Narrow the structure by including the selections without children as filters. The selections are added to the filter criteria using the AND operator.
includeWithoutChildrenAndTooltip: Children are not included for filtering.
packPropertyWarningTooltip:
While filtering and packing, the element selected
to pack the structure may not accurately represent
what the structure will look like when unpacked.
proximityTooltip: Filter all elements within the specified distance from the selected target elements.
replayWorksetTooltip: Replay the selection to update it with the latest applied configurations and filters. If the selection is a Workset, all modified structures within it are updated.
replayTooltip: Воспроизведите сессию, чтобы получить последние результаты.
replayDateTooltip: Сессия была в последний раз воспроизведена:
resetConfirmationSession: The view will be reset to the last saved configurations and filters of the session.
resetConfirmationWorkset: The view will be reset to its default.
resetSessionTooltip: Reset the view to the last saved configurations and filters of the session.
resetWorksetTooltip: Reset the view to the last saved configurations and filters of the Workset and its related products.
saveSessionTooltip: Сохраните конфигурацию и отфильтруйте изменения в сессии.
saveWorksetTooltip: Сохраните примененные конфигурации и фильтры в рабочий набор. Также будут сохранены обновления, выполненные для рабочего набора и содержащихся в нем структур.
saveAsWorksetWithPersistedChanges: Несохраненные изменения в рабочем наборе не сохранены. Сохраненное состояние рабочего набора использовалось для создания нового объекта.
saveAsWorksetWithNoWriteAccess: Этот новый рабочий набор не включает несохраненные изменения, поскольку у вас нет необходимых прав на изменение исходного рабочего набора.
showExcludedByFilteringDesc: Toggle to show or hide occurrences that are excluded by the currently applied filters.
sessionCmdGroupTooltip: Воспроизведите или сбросьте сессию или сохраните новую.
thresholdExceeded: The search for "{0}" could take a long time. You may cancel and refine the search criteria, or you can continue to wait for the search results to load.
worksetHeaderLabel: Select a product (direct child of workset) in the content table below to view or modify its context expression.
notifyAppliedVariantRuleWithConfigureByP: Конфигурация может быть не полной, так как вы применили и "Сконфигурировать по близости", и "Вариантное правило".
configureByProximityTooltip: Целевые объекты для близости будут использоваться для конфигурации
noFacetsFoundMessage: Try refining the current Filter criteria.
